rhythm.title: Keep the bend-and-rise rhythm
rhythm.drill: Film five relaxed shadow serves. Let the knee bend flow into the upward movement without forcing a deeper bend.
rhythm.success_check: Compare the five clips: does the rise continue without an added pause? Keep the repetitions that feel comfortable and repeatable.
rhythm.purpose: Compare whether your knee bend flows into the rise across repetitions.

baseline.title: Check your room behind the baseline
baseline.cue: Leave a little more room behind the baseline while keeping your natural step.
baseline.drill: Film five easy serves with a low camera showing your feet and the baseline. Start a little farther back, keeping your natural step.
baseline.success_check: Check for visible space between your shoes and the baseline before takeoff. If the line or shoes are hidden, improve the camera angle before judging.
baseline.purpose: Check visible shoe clearance before takeoff without treating this clip as a foot-fault diagnosis.

toss_check.title: Check toss placement from the side
toss_check.cue: Check toss placement from the side before changing it.
toss_check.drill: Film five comfortable serves to the same target from the side, with the ball, racket and feet in frame.
toss_check.success_check: Check whether a backward reach repeats across the serves. Only consider changing toss placement after the side view supports that concern.
toss_check.purpose: Use a side recording to investigate whether backward reaching repeats, before changing toss placement.

preparation.title: Make your preparation repeatable
preparation.cue: Start comfortably and repeat the same relaxed arm rise.
preparation.drill: Film five easy shadow motions from the same comfortable setup. Let the arms rise naturally; do not force a fixed height.
preparation.success_check: Compare the starting position and arm-rise path across repetitions. Choose a comfortable sequence you can repeat.
preparation.purpose: Compare your starting position and arm-rise path across repetitions.

recovery.title: Finish the motion before resetting
recovery.cue: Let the motion finish, then reset for the next repetition.
recovery.drill: Film five relaxed shadow serves, allowing the arms and body to finish moving before returning to your starting position.
recovery.success_check: Check that you can finish each repetition and reset without rushing into the next one. This is a practice check, not a measured balance score.
recovery.purpose: Compare whether you finish each motion before resetting for the next repetition.

recapture.title: Get a clearer view of the movement
recapture.cue: Record one uninterrupted movement with your feet and overhead space visible.
recapture.drill: Use the original uninterrupted single-player video, rather than a paused or split-screen recording. Include setup, the upward action and recovery, with room above the racket.
recapture.success_check: The new recording should show the whole movement clearly, including the feet and overhead space, without pauses or cuts.
recapture.purpose: A clear uninterrupted recording lets us follow the movement without guessing through repeated or missing frames.
